scheme_name: Educational Assistance To Children Of Prisoners (Pursuing Professional Course)
other_conditions: Applicant must be a native and resident of Kerala
Applicant must be the child of a prisoner sentenced to life imprisonment or death sentence
Applicant must have been admitted to the course on a merit basis
Applicant must have secured 70% or above marks in Higher secondary examinations
Assistance is for degree‑level professional courses in Government/Aided colleges inside Kerala
For courses like MBBS and B.VSc., assistance is provided only if studying in Government colleges
If both parents are convicts and the child is cared for by a relative who is Above Poverty Line, the application is considered based on a Probation Officer’s inquiry report
Preference will be given based on percentage of marks when more applicants are present
benefits_summary: Provides up to ₹100,000 per student to cover tuition and hostel fees for degree‑level professional courses in government/ aided colleges.
